library(tidyverse)

library(furrr)


wd <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

child_path <- function(file) {
  if (wd == "D:/GIT/PhD_project") {
    file.path(
      "..", "..", "phd_project_wp2", "writings", "pom",
      "r_scripts", "paper", file
    )
  } else {
    file.path("r_scripts", "paper", file)
  }
}

project_path <- function(path) {
  candidates <- c(
    path,
    file.path("..", "..", path),
    file.path("..", "..", "phd_project_wp2", path),
    file.path("..", "..", "..", "phd_project_wp2", path)
  )
  
  existing_path <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  
  if (length(existing_path) == 0) {
    stop("Could not find file: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  existing_path[[1]]
}
